candidate_policy: code only; positive after-cost measured edge with evidence digest required per rule; no model-originated candidates; ETF/news/PEAD/leader rules not enabled without implementation and measured evidence

cadence.decision: 12:45 UTC each NYSE session, start tolerance 180s
cadence.watch: regular NYSE hours once per minute

model_calls.planned: one extraction, one analyst, one independent GPT contradictor per day; no retries; quota halts day; no dispatch 15:30-17:00 UTC

primary: full normalized filing text; raw and text digests; received_at after response; no truncation; exact-substring citations; no primary evidence fails AI closed
execution: premarket previous-close provisional size; fresh regular-session quote strictly after approval; no entry after open+5min; resizes only downward in Python; later observed bid for stops and five-session time exit

evaluation.unit: each code-selected candidate with later entry and completed five-session-or-stop outcome
evaluation.factors: extraction: zero on cited cut/dilution/accounting/legal; veto: zero on either VETO; sizing: half on either SIZE_DOWN; combined applies active factors
evaluation.paired: same candidates, baseline quote/fill/stop/horizon/costs; unused size held in cash; no capacity-reallocation claim
evaluation.disable: permanent prospective removal from combined when >=40 completed valid candidate decisions and cumulative paired net PnL delta <=0; no tuning; diagnostics retained
evaluation.correctness: semantic extraction accuracy UNMEASURED until independent operator fact adjudication; exact substring alone proves citation only
evaluation.statistics: report cluster-days; 40 is a governance threshold, not statistical significance

activation: new private runtime only; exact code SHA, spec/prereg/implementation, grant digest, successful exact-SHA CI, local checks, recent producer proof, explicit single-owner review; no migration or automatic promotion
replay: requirement waived by the pinned operator grant; prospective evidence only
limitations: IEX partial feed, displayed size does not guarantee execution
minute quotes can miss stop touches; overnight gaps can exceed initial risk
primary retrieval and CLI transport require forward verification
local registry, measured-edge attestation, and complete macro/earnings calendar are operator-supplied; no fabricated empty calendars
Codex CLI served model identity is not attested; requested identity is recorded
paired arms measure same-candidate allocated capital, not independent portfolio capacity
